facts.claim: The red-brick Marunouchi facade is on the west side of Tokyo Station; Yaesu exits face east. The station connects JR Yamanote and Marunouchi metro lines.
facts.sourceHeading: Tokyo Station & Marunouchi area travel guide
facts.evidenceExcerpt: head for one of the Marunouchi exits to go west

facts.claim: GRANSTA spans areas inside and outside ticket gates; Character Street is inside First Avenue Tokyo Station.
facts.evidenceExcerpt: shopping areas both inside and outside the ticket gates
